Respond in Chinese if the user's last message is Chinese, English otherwise.

userStories.notes: Completed 2026-04-24. Two-file prompt+glue change. (1) lib/agent/nlu-v2/router.ts · buildStateSummary: added a planning-assumptions suffix (' Planning assumptions: a; b.') appended to every branch — the early-return no-scenario branch AND the main scenario branch — so the chat layer always sees assumptions regardless of scenario.
